The cited evidence (E1, E2) shows that nonequilibrium SRO can form during processing and can improve strength–ductility, but neither passage involves femtosecond laser melting, AlCrFeNiSi, or demonstrates residual stress reduction via this mechanism. The key processing–structure–property links are therefore largely unsupported by the provided evidence.
